_note: SYNTHETIC demo data, not this repository's live state. It deliberately carries every state the page can render -- one blocked beat, one satisfied, two refusals, and both evidence kinds -- because a demo missing a state cannot show what that state looks like. This repository's own live graph currently compiles ZERO beats, which is correct and is what `build_beatgraph_html.py --repo .` renders.

beats.reason: deploy-docs publishes numbers the coverage run produces; publishing before it has run ships last week's figures as this week's.
the release notes are assembled from the audit summary; releasing without it produces notes with nothing behind them.

refused.why: check_ingest_prereqs checks BOTH artifacts with isfile, and only when gap_source is 'self-assess-brief'. A beat fires unconditionally, so it would deny andon-loop in its default self-scan mode, which needs no brief at all.
cupertino-council writes nothing durable -- a brief, a tension log and code, all in conversation. A beat gating on it would deny forever, with no way to satisfy it.

produces.meaning: the audit ran and its findings are on record
the design council ran before any UI code was written
produces.why: the council produces a brief, a tension log and code, all in conversation; nothing durable is written

produces.meaning: a calibrated review pass has findings on record
one named wire has been proven against evidence
produces.why: andon-verify is forbidden to write; andon-loop persists the result, so nothing marks that one wire was proven
